About the Winning Comic...

-> Charisma Check ~30-40 pages
-> Tone: lighthearted
-> Characters: Clara & Jacob

-> Geoff is throwing a party at his house, and has invited many friends, including his stoically promiscuous girlfriend Clara, to attend and whoop it up through the night. Geoff's younger brother Jacob isn't so keen to get involved, and shuts himself away in his room. Clara, losing interest in the party, discovers Jacob and decides to create her own entertainment by giving Jacob his first taste of sex. While bringing Jacob out of his shell, she inadvertently comes out of her own... just a little bit.
